description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to custom profile attributes in the Mattermost project, including validation, sanitization, and patching logic for custom profile attribute fields.

classes.name: CPAField
classes.description: Represents a custom profile attribute field with associated attributes and validation logic.

classes.name: CPAAttrs
classes.description: Holds the attributes of a CPAField, including visibility, options, value type, LDAP/SAML info, and management status.

classes.name: CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption
classes.description: Represents an option for select-type custom profile attributes, with validation for ID, name, and color.

methods.name: IsKnownCPAValueType
methods.description: Checks if a given value type string is among the recognized types (email, url, phone).

methods.name: IsKnownCPAVisibility
methods.description: Checks if a given visibility string is among the recognized options (hidden, when_set, always).

methods.name: GetID
methods.description: Returns the ID of a CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of a CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption.

methods.name: SetID
methods.description: Sets the ID of a CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the CustomProfileAttributesSelectOption's ID, name, and color.

methods.name: IsSynced
methods.description: Determines if the CPAField is synchronized with external sources (LDAP or SAML).

methods.name: IsAdminManaged
methods.description: Checks if the CPAField is managed by an admin.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for a CPAField, particularly the visibility.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a PropertyFieldPatch to the CPAField, converting to and from PropertyField for patch logic.

methods.name: ToPropertyField
methods.description: Converts a CPAField to a PropertyField structure.

methods.name: SupportsOptions
methods.description: Checks if the CPAField type supports options (select or multiselect).

methods.name: SupportsSyncing
methods.description: Checks if the CPAField type supports syncing with external sources.

methods.name: SanitizeAndValidate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the CPAField's attributes, ensuring correctness based on type and constraints.

methods.name: NewCPAFieldFromPropertyField
methods.description: Creates a new CPAField from a generic PropertyField, parsing attributes from JSON.

methods.name: SanitizeAndValidatePropertyValue
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a raw property value based on the CPAField's type and attributes.
